assertions.requirement: Selective re-evaluation deterministically retains every required deterministic correctness/safety failure.
Hash-valid retained state is bound to the exact plan, attempt, candidate identity, evaluator configuration, evidence, and evaluation identities; cross-attempt replay fails closed.
Malformed deterministic protocol output is invalid infrastructure truth with unknown quality.
Timeout applies bounded TERM grace, process-group KILL, and reap to SIGTERM-resistant descendants.
The v2 report exposes authoritative millisecond attempt/evaluator/aggregate wall runtime with provenance while costs remain separate.
